** sch_path: <tmp>/xschem_export/elab-inv_tb/export/root/inv_tb.sch
**.subckt inv_tb
X1 in out inv wn=0.5 wp=2 l=0.15
VVDD vdd! 0 dc 'vdd'
VVIN in 0 dc 'vdd/2'
CCL out 0 10f
**** begin user architecture code

.param vdd=1.8


.lib models.lib tt
.temp 27


.tran 1p 1n

**** end user architecture code
**.ends

* expanding   symbol:  root/inv.sym # of pins=2
** sym_path: <tmp>/xschem_export/elab-inv_tb/export/root/inv.sym
** sch_path: <tmp>/xschem_export/elab-inv_tb/export/root/inv.sch
.subckt inv A Y  wn=1 wp=2 l=0.15
*.ipin A
*.opin Y
MMN Y A 0 0 nfet W='(wn)*1u' L='(l)*1u' nf=1 ad='((wn)*0.29)*1p'
MMP Y A vdd! vdd! pfet W='(wp)*1u' L='(l)*1u'
.ends

.GLOBAL vdd!
.end
